data.title: Al Andalus
data.about:
Al Andalus at Jumeirah Golf Estates is home to 2 championship golf courses, Fire & Earth. The 1-4 apartments are ready and you can enjoy the amazing views of the golf courses. One of the 16 beautifully crafted clusters of Jumeirah Golf Estates, Al Andalus is an ideal and green place to call home.

With high ease of living and exclusivity that is out of the world, at Al Andalus you will live with the best of modern conveniences and comforts. Spread over 6 hectares of open spaces, Al Andalus gives you 5 km of walking path ways, landscaped gardens and an ideal location. Live just minutes from the Al Maktoum International Airport and a Dubai Metro station.

location_tile.title: When you live at Al Andalus, you are living within Jumeirah Golf Estates.
location_tile.description:
Just minutes away from most of the city’s major landmarks, JGE is the ideal place to find a home as it is here you will find peace and quiet. With nature surrounding the area on every side, this is the luxury you can afford.

  • 09 mins – Dubai Sports City
  • 13 mins – Dubai Production City

  • 22 mins – Dubai Marina

  • 34 mins – Al Maktoum International Airport | Dubai International Airport
